text:
maya: Heads-up: onboarding container logs show full request ids in JSON logs when OTEL env is set in container image.

owen: which image?

maya: the go-sample container (onboarding v1.8). Start command: `docker run -e OTEL_AUTO=true redwood/sample-go:1.8` then curl /generate with `x-request-id: clz_deadbeefcafebabe`. The structured JSON log has req_id field unredacted.

ravi: I can repro. Looks like the logrus JSON formatter gets called before our redact hook when OTEL injects context in the middleware chain for Go. Node and Python behaved differently. SDK parity gap.

maya: snippet (redacted):
```
{"level":"info","ts":"2026-03-23T14:04:10Z","msg":"request","req_id":"clz_deadbeefcafebabe","user":"bob@example.com"}
{"level":"debug","ts":"2026-03-23T14:04:10Z","otel":"tracing","trace_id":"8a7f..."}
```

owen: not great. Because it's JSON logs, our stdout scrubber trick is brittle (could corrupt JSON). Need a proper fix in SDK.

ravi: proposed short-term: change onboarding container default to OTEL_AUTO=false and bump sample image tag to 1.8.1; for longer term: add a `Telemetry.PostRedact` hook in Go SDK that runs after instrumentation and before final log emit. Also add `redwood.telemetry.redact_rules` (list of regex) to SDK config.

ci-bot: created PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/samples/pull/217 to flip OTEL_AUTO default in onboarding images and add a test asserting no `clz_` pattern in JSON logs at INFO level.

infra-bot: deploy hold flagged for onboarding images until PR merged.

own: follow-up: Ravi can you draft the Go SDK API for PostRedact? I can mirror in Node/Python for parity. Keep the API minimal: function(redactor func(map[string]string) map[string]string) or similar.

ravi: will sketch API and post in RFC doc. Quick regex we used locally (needs review): `clz_[0-9a-f]{8,}` -> `clz_<redacted>`

maya: thanks — I pushed a small changelog note to onboarding ticket and attached the logs. We'll wait for PR review then update images. :thumbsup:
